source: printed pages 57-58 read off the renders (_renders/page-1.png, _renders/page-2.png); the whole poem is typeset across those two folios in a loose two-block-per-page layout with the four Krishna-Radha paintings set between the verse blocks
notes: Printed order equals logical order for this chapter. Reading order down folio 57 is: the title masthead with its byline (top), the ટેક block (upper left), કડી 1 (middle right), કડી 2 (lower left). Down folio 58: કડી 3 (top right), કડી 4 (upper left), કડી 5 (middle right), and the ટેક reprinted as the closing block (lower left). Verse blocks alternate left and right around the paintings, so the order was read off the renders rather than assumed from a single column.

Only teaching text is listed. Not in this list, because they are not topics: the blue પ્રવેશપેટી on folio 57, the શબ્દાર્થ box and the રૂઢિપ્રયોગ box on folio 59, the full-page રાસલીલા picture on folio 61 (it belongs to exercise block 10, not to the poem), and all twelve numbered સ્વાધ્યાય blocks on folios 59-62. No વ્યાકરણ એકમ, પૂરકવાચન piece or 'આગળ વધતાં પહેલાં' revision unit falls inside this chapter's page range.
M1.S1.T1 heads the list because the masthead it rests on is the first printed thing on folio 57, above the poem. It is a pre-reading topic, not a verse unit.
Emitted so Agent 15 compares against an explicit index rather than an assumption; no divergence from the logical order exists to flag.
